test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All terraces are lawns.

All lawns are grounds.

No ground is a field.

Conclusions:

(I) No terrace is a field.

(II) Some grounds are terraces.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7858b3b270069986f13fc353cd38f33a7feebce5f1c3b8fc77603796f013ce68.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No terrace is a field → True (As, All terraces are lawns, All lawns are grounds, No ground is a field. so, No terrace is a field holds true)

(II) Some grounds are terraces → True (As, All terraces are lawns, All lawns are grounds, No ground is a field. so, Some grounds are terraces true)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
